Summary.en: Allows an upload field to accept several files, with an optional maximum and messages.
Summary.de: Ermöglicht einem Upload-Feld, mehrere Dateien zu akzeptieren, mit optionalem Maximum und Meldungen.
Summary.it: Consente a un campo di upload di accettare più file, con un massimo opzionale e messaggi.

Parameter.Maximum: The number of files that may be uploaded.
Parameter.PrefixTooMany: The message that is displayed before the Maximum if too many files were selected.
Parameter.PostfixTooMany: The message that is displayed after the Maximum if too many files were selected.

Maximum.description: The number of files that may be uploaded.
Maximum.descriptionDe: Die Anzahl der Dateien, die hochgeladen werden dürfen.
Maximum.descriptionIt: Il numero di file che possono essere caricati.

PrefixTooMany.description: The message that is displayed before the Maximum if too many files were selected.
PrefixTooMany.descriptionDe: Die Meldung, die vor dem Maximum angezeigt wird, wenn zu viele Dateien ausgewählt wurden.
PrefixTooMany.descriptionIt: Il messaggio mostrato prima di Maximum se sono stati selezionati troppi file.

PostfixTooMany.description: The message that is displayed after the Maximum if too many files were selected.
PostfixTooMany.descriptionDe: Die Meldung, die nach dem Maximum angezeigt wird, wenn zu viele Dateien ausgewählt wurden.
PostfixTooMany.descriptionIt: Il messaggio mostrato dopo Maximum se sono stati selezionati troppi file.
